changelog: WhatsApp Business app coexistence (QR) onboarding + Embedded Signup fixes (race, popup blocking, CANCEL/ERROR events).
Coexistence webhooks: smb_message_echoes, history, smb_app_state_sync; history/echo media is downloaded when under 14 days old.
Web Cron URL (/cron/run/<key>) for servers without a system cron; Meta webhooks are also processed right after the 200 reply.
Trial-expired / subscription-expired status on the admin tenant list, the tenant dashboard and the billing page.
Manual connect: optional two-step PIN; generated PINs are shown to the tenant; temporary tokens are detected and expiry warnings are scheduled.
Coexistence badge + limitations notice; /admin/system-health redirects to /admin/health.
